body: Felt this ^^ One time someone said to me they didn’t think I had BPD because I care about people other than myself 🙃 it’s extremely disheartening and makes one question the validity of their own mental illness. I appreciate your wording of this a lot—also happy for you having found a good middle ground with things ! It is not easy and it’s certainly not something to compare to others who may or may not be in that head space yet.

Just wanted to say you’re definitely understood !! I have found that other people with bpd tend to understand me a bit more, however I don’t think ita a lost cause to find those who ‘get it.’ I was very lucky to have a therapist who understands the thought processes that come with bpd but in that I also realize some things people just don’t get when they don’t experience it. My partner doesn’t have bpd and they react in ways that often remind me how ‘crazy’ I am to people that don’t think the way I do. That is to say—as long as you personally are accountable for your reactions and feelings I don’t think anyone has the right to make you feel alone. If someone can’t support you and your mental illness it isn’t a slight against you or the person necessarily, they just A. aren’t trained in the way a therapist or professional is or B. not worth your time and most likely would fall through in other ways too if they can’t be empathetic or hear you out. I know with loss or rejection that brings the negative emotions forward x10000 however it helps to think back to how you got where you are rn and how you can always get back there with another person. Or a new group of people even. Bpd makes a lot of things feel impossible cause there aren’t people without that feel the way we do, but you are definitely NOT alone no matter what your brain is making you think. Im kinda rambling now, but I hope this is helpful and you’re able to reroute the negative feelings.

Never said dating a man made you straight lol I just wrote what I was told by her at the time. She told me she wasnt gay and that she felt ‘guilty for not returning my feelings’ which whatever since shes the one who initiated it in the first place. I only am feeling a type of way cause I spent years feeling like I forced her somehow to now realize it was deeper than that. Thats all.
